description: This file contains SQL schema definitions, functions, and procedures for managing streaming messages, dead letters, and control data in a PostgreSQL database for Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Inserts a new message into the OrleansStreamMessage table with a specified payload and expiry timeout.

methods.name: GetStreamMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and updates a batch of stream messages for processing, handling eviction scheduling.

methods.name: ConfirmStreamMessages
methods.description: Confirms and deletes processed stream messages based on provided message IDs and dequeued counts.

methods.name: FailStreamMessage
methods.description: Marks a message as failed, either resetting its visibility or moving it to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamMessages
methods.description: Evicts messages that have expired or been dequeued too many times, moving them to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamDeadLetters
methods.description: Removes dead letter messages that are due for eviction based on the RemoveOn timestamp.
